event.content:
Create an application for a commercial complex where there are business units. The commercial complex is a coppertaive which is managed by a management committee and a facilities management team 
The Aim of this portal is to update the happenings/events and notice to the society members
Allow them to build their profile of the business that there are in , provide for 2 contact numbeber and email so that members can search the portal for any business association and call them up 
There should be also a provision to raise a business query like does anyone know a lawyer - the same will be forwarded to all the "lawyers" in the complex 
There should be a provision to mention if the owner is using it or it os gives on rent , if given on rent the member can add a contact with email  also it can authorise the tenenat to update the tenant profile - so that the tenant can login also in the portal screen when searched say unit D715 which is on rent and if the owners allowed it will show the companies name in bracket (Tenant ) and then the profile of the tenant 
On the profile page if the tenenat page comes up , there should be an option to click the owner profile
Member profile is a must in addition one can have a tenant profile for the unit - only one member profile and tenenat profile is available for the unit number 
In the profile have a provision to add parking details - like parking slot and vehicle numbers , a unit may have multiple parking slots and multiple cars - multiple cars can be registered to each parking slot 

Create a provision for advertisement banner on the portal this will be banners in a carasole  like fashion with a billing system people can by minimum monthly banner slots and it will be visible in all the portal pages 

There will be types of users , 
1.owners/members
2.Tenanats ( onklky if rights are provided) - owner should have the authority to delete the tenenat from his unit or remove his login 
Management team - who have administrative rights to create members and notices , events and so on 
3.Facility team to address the concerns of the members and security 

There are multiple wings and floors and each unit has a unit number 
Each unit has an owner or can have multiple joint owners , there are the the members who will use the 

Add any more feature that you think is required for a smooth functioning of the premise create a provision foe entry of guest in the building also , which will be checked by the security
Starting **Build mode** — I'll plan this end to end, show you the phases, and pause for your review at each one. You can stop at any point, continue phase by phase, or let me complete everything.

event.question: I understand this is a members' portal for a cooperative commercial complex, where the management committee and facilities team keep owners and tenants informed, help them find each other's businesses, and run day-to-day operations. I intend to build business unit and member/tenant profiles with parking, notices and events, business queries routed to the right trade, paid advertising banners, and guest entry for security.

scope.summary: I understand this is a members' portal for a cooperative commercial complex, where the management committee and facilities team keep owners and tenants informed, help them find each other's businesses, and run day-to-day operations. I intend to build business unit and member/tenant profiles with parking, notices and events, business queries routed to the right trade, paid advertising banners, and guest entry for security.

questions.question: Which functional areas should the application include?

options.label: Units & profiles
options.description: Wings, floors and units, joint owners, owner/tenant profiles with 2 phones and email, and parking slots with vehicles.

options.label: Business directory
options.description: Search members by business, name or unit number, with tenant shown in brackets and a link back to the owner.

options.label: Notices & events
options.description: Management posts notices and events that all members can view.

options.label: Business queries
options.description: Members post a query such as 'need a lawyer' and it goes to all members in that trade.

options.label: Ad banners & billing
options.description: Rotating banners on every page, sold as monthly slots with invoices and payment tracking.

options.label: Guest entry & security
options.description: Members pre-register visitors and security checks them in and out at the gate.

options.label: Facility requests
options.description: Members raise complaints or service requests and the facilities team tracks them to closure.

options.label: Maintenance dues
options.description: Maintenance charges, bills and payment status for each unit.

questions.question: How detailed should the first version be?

options.label: Lean MVP
options.description: Core profiles, directory, notices and simple guest log with minimal screens.

options.label: Standard
options.description: All selected modules with sensible workflows, search, and basic reports.

options.label: Comprehensive
options.description: Full workflows, approvals, notifications, detailed reports and dashboards for every team.

questions.question: How should advertising banner booking and billing work?

options.label: Simple booking
options.description: Management records the advertiser, month(s), amount and payment status manually.

options.label: Self-service booking
options.description: Advertisers pick available monthly slots, upload their banner and management approves it.

options.label: Booking with invoices
options.description: Self-service booking plus automatic invoices, due dates and renewal reminders.

options.label: Pre-registration
options.description: Members register expected guests and security verifies them at the gate.

options.label: Approval at gate
options.description: Security logs walk-in guests and the member approves or declines the entry.

options.label: Both
options.description: Pre-registration plus gate approval for unexpected visitors, with an entry/exit log.

**Built, but not everything behaves as required yet.** I used each screen through the app; after one fix these still differ from the requirement. Ask me to fix any of them.

**the application as a whole**
This could not be fully checked by using the application:
I'll start by listing the objects and describing the screens.

Wrong tool usage; use design_query run-select.

Try a create to see if the engine path works.

The whole-application check could not run. Every tool that reads stored rows (`design_query.py run-select`, `db_inspect.py query`, `visual-data`, `dashboard-data`) fails with `FATAL: too many connections for role "bl_9783c670_…"`. I retried over about three minutes (several attempts spaced 20 to 40 seconds apart) and it never cleared.

What did work: `describe` for all 17 screens, and one `create` of a test wing (`ZV`, `[verify] wing`), which the engine accepted. I then deleted that wing and the delete reported 1 row removed, so I left no records behind.

Without read-back I can't compare any stored value with what the request states. That rules out the flow checks (enter masters, then member profile, tenant, parking, notice, event, query, banner booking and payment, guest entry, facility request through its statuses). It also rules out the cross-screen rules and the figures (the 10 lists and 4 dashboards). `create` and `run-action` only print a short confirmation, not the stored values, so none of this can be verified by running the app. I have not declared any of it passing or failing.

Every check is inconclusive. I did not create the rest of the ~30 records, because I couldn't confirm any result and would only have created more records to clean up.

The database role is out of connection slots, probably held by stale or leaked sessions from the running preview app or a previous agent session. Once those are released, this run is worth repeating.

**Not confirmed when I used the application as a whole.** These could not be settled by trying them; they are not known to be wrong. Ask me to look into any of them.

- Flow: masters (wing, unit, categories, rate plan, purposes) then member profile with joint owners, tenant profile, parking with vehicles: Only a wing create was accepted by the engine; stored values could not be read because the DB role has no connection slots left
- Flow: notice publish to expiry, event publish/cancel: Not run
- Flow: business query forwarded to recipients, response, close/reopen: Not run
- Flow: banner booking, approve, record payment, cancel/reject: Not run
- Flow: guest entry and security check-in/out; facility request assign/resolve/close: Not run
- Rules spanning two screens (rent/owner block, tenant flags, delete blocks, parking ownership, notice board window): Not run
- Figures on 10 lists and 4 dashboards: Not run; visual-data and dashboard-data read the same database

I did not create any records, and nothing was changed or left behind.

- **Tenant Profile unit test:** not run. I have no tool here that runs the unit test, and I couldn't read the current state of unit ZT101 to set it up. `app_api.py list-objects` and `describe` worked, but every `run-select` and `db_inspect` query failed.
- **What I could confirm from the models:** the change appears to be built.

2. Create a tenant with two different other categories and read them back from `CCW_TENANT_CATEGORY`.

5. Run Re-activate on a ZT101 test row, then clean up.

I am getting an error [UNIT_FLOOR] Floor 7 must be between 0 and the wing's number of floors ().
when I am entering 7

**Verdict: PARTLY confirmed.** The error is real and happens on every save attempt I can see, but I could not prove the cause. The database role was refusing connections ("too many connections for role bl_…"), so I could not read the wing master or the unit rows.

**What the user sees**
- Screen: `ccw_unit_master` (Unit Master). Save fails with `floor_no: [UNIT_FLOOR] Floor 7 must be between 0 and the wing's number of floors `.
- The bound is blank, not 0 or a number.

**Evidence**

What should be the size of the banner for a web and mobile

**Recommended banner sizes**

| Placement | Desktop / Web | Mobile |
|---|---|---|
| Standard banner | **1200 × 400 px** (3:1) | **800 × 400 px** (2:1) |
| Full-width hero | 1920 × 600 px | 750 × 500 px |

**Guidelines**
- **Format:** JPG or PNG (WebP is fine for smaller files).
- **File size:** under 500 KB for fast loading.
- **Safe zone:** keep text and logos in the central ~80% of the image, since edges get cropped on different screen widths.
- **Resolution:** export at 2× (for example, 2400 × 800) if you want sharp display on high-DPI screens.

If you can use only one image for both web and mobile, use **1200 × 400 px** and keep key content centered.
